headline: Kyrgyzstan wants to export dried fruits, nuts and honey to Bulgaria
summary: Kyrgyz Deputy Minister of Water Resources, Agriculture and Processing Industry Asylbek Satyvaldiev met with officials to discuss exporting dried fruit, nuts and honey to Bulgaria.
why: Agricultural export access to European Union markets such as Bulgaria is a route for Central Asian producers to earn foreign currency and diversify trade.
original_headline: Кыргызстан хочет экспортировать сухофрукты, орехи и мед в Болгарию
